reviewContext.issueReference: feat/ai-capture audit round 2 (base 0a35708, head 3cd2401ce1044d7c51dc0f4af9b0a6d4457e8589): 10 blocking findings
reviewContext.userProblem: Round 2 of the audit of the 3D CAD pages and the AI capture feature on feat/ai-capture (0a35708..3cd2401) found ten blocking findings, two high and eight medium. (1) Capture applies a shared cut to a solid block that the editor rejects when one target is an open mesh. (2) A stale PCB board-picker choice can still be committed. (3) The four-million-point limit is enforced only after all geometry is allocated. (4) Loop normalisation is quadratic for perforated plates. (5) Mesh bounds are scanned in the interpreter on native capture and native SVG export. (6) Interference discovery compares all pairs. (7) Mesh closure is reclassified repeatedly. (8) Wireframe export ignores PCB page eligibility. (9) Wireframe export treats a corrupt mesh as a body. (10) Raster-plan and frame rounding disagree.
requiredOutcomes: function-open-mesh-multitarget-cut (R2-1; plans a1-rust-decoder, a1-ts-decoder, a2-native-host, a2-core-wiring, a4-open-mesh-targets): eligibility follows design 19.1 F1 rules (a)-(d), computed in Rust on the native path; both decoders agree on the nine fixtures; a cut shared by a block and an ineligible mesh reports cad.body.missing, leaves every target unchanged and fails a sketch on its face; the open surface stays visible; block NCS1 bytes and pixels equal the suppressed-cut control; the closed-mesh controls cut both targets; the scene.test.ts single-triangle difference expectation is replaced.

function-pcb-reference-page-kind (R2-2; plan p-picker-guard): board-picker.tsx re-checks isPcbBoardChoice on a fresh snapshot at commit; a stale choice adds no history, creates no reference, preserves the selection, shows the existing notice and closes; after Undo the restored choice inserts exactly once.

performance-capture-point-limit-after-allocation (R2-3; plans a5-point-rule, a5-charged-walk, with a1 decoders): one shared point rule in scene-binary.ts; each tool is charged before allocation and meshes get the remaining vertex allowance; zero geometry allocations from the overflowing tool onward; diagnostic precedence unchanged; admitted NCS1 bytes identical.

performance-capture-loop-normalization-pair-scans (R2-4; plan a3-loop-normalisation): depth-bucketed ancestor search; ancestor probes grow at most ~linearly as holes double (previously 252,002 / 1,004,002 / 4,008,002); full, partial and nested-island selections equal the pre-fix oracle; scene bytes identical.

performance-native-mesh-bounds (R2-5; plans a2-native-host, a2-core-wiring, a2-export-bounds): shaded native capture takes bounds from the Rust decoder; native construction SVG export uses a bounds-only operation through CommandIo, SvgExportOptions, renderPageSvg and cadPageWireframe with zero TS decodes; six extrema, cameras, NCS1 and SVG bytes match on asymmetric negative-coordinate geometry; TS fallback and invalid input preserved; native parity passes against a fresh release CLI.

performance-interference-sparse-pairs (R2-6; plan c1-sweep): single-axis sweep; comparison counts on separated X rows, Y rows and sparse grids grow sub-quadratically; totals, weights, ordered pairs, checked prefixes and unchecked lists equal exhaustive enumeration; the dense 2,000-body test still passes.

performance-capture-repeated-mesh-closure (R2-7; plan c2-closure-once, after a1-rust-decoder's closed_by): CLOSURE_EVALUATIONS shows one classification per mesh tool per render with analysis disabled, an overlapping three-axis pair and a census case; body states, reports and image bytes identical at 1 and 8 threads; first-tool body rule and renderer-closure versus booleanTarget distinction preserved.

maintainability-wireframe-pcb-input (R2-8; plan b-wireframe): renderPageSvg CAD branch uses collectCadInput; public SVG export gives SVG before PCB-to-freeform conversion, null after, and the original bytes after Undo.

maintainability-wireframe-mesh-failure (R2-9; plans b-wireframe, a2-export-bounds): a failed or empty mesh decode returns false from the wireframe visitor; a corrupt mesh with a dependent cut gives zero segments and null bounds; the valid-mesh control draws both.

maintainability-capture-raster-rounding (R2-10; plan r-raster-rounding): captureRasterPlan computes integer dimensions once with the renderer rule; a 10000 x 100 viewport at scale 0.07 and with a 700 x 7 box both give scale 0.07 and a 700 x 7 frame; over-limit and deterministic PNG tests still pass.
Repository lint, typecheck and existing tests pass; final integration runs bun run typecheck, bun run lint, CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true mise run verify and native parity against a fresh release build.

AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, strict typing; cargo always with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true and a plan-local CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/car2-<plan>; rustfmt on touched Rust files only.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: 14 plans in five waves (design 20.3): wave 1 a1-rust-decoder, a1-ts-decoder, a3-loop-normalisation, a5-point-rule, b-wireframe, c1-sweep, p-picker-guard, r-raster-rounding; wave 2 a2-native-host, c2-closure-once; wave 3 a2-core-wiring, a2-export-bounds; wave 4 a4-open-mesh-targets; wave 5 a5-charged-walk.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Dependencies exist only for real contracts or same-file ordering; same-wave writePaths are disjoint; every completed wave keeps native capture decoding in Rust.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Budgeted decoder added beside the existing entry points in every layer (decode_inline_with, decodeCaptureMeshWith, nmeshCapture, CommandIo.decodeCaptureMesh), returning counts, millimetre bounds, optional booleanTarget and geometry only within maxVertices.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: One seam serves R2-1 eligibility, R2-3 remaining allowance and R2-5 Rust bounds while cad check keeps its packet and types (design 20.4).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Packet writer and reader land in one plan (a2-native-host); the caller switches in one plan (a2-core-wiring) one wave later.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: No completed wave has a writer without its reader or an interpreter decode on the native CLI.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Rust eligibility rule (a) reuses the renderer closure code through mesh::closed_by with a quantized position accessor.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Renderer closure and eligibility closure cannot drift, and the over-limit path reads positions without allocating capture geometry.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R2-1 is implemented as a display-only mesh visitor result in construction.ts.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The existing absent-target rule then fails the whole feature with cad.body.missing before any step, matching the editor, while the surface stays drawn.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Shared point rule (MAX_POINTS, checkScenePreTool, chargeTool) lives in scene-binary.ts and the writer calls it.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: One owner for the limit; charging before allocation preserves messages and precedence.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Interference broad phase is a single-axis sweep on the axis with the fewest relaxed overlaps; closure is classified once per render and passed through crate-internal _with variants.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: No cell size needed, output easy to compare with exhaustive enumeration; LatticeRequest and existing signatures stay source-compatible.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Loop normalisation uses depth buckets, not a complete-profile shortcut.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Provably equal to the current max-containing-depth result for every selection, so bytes cannot change.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Checkpoint added car2-r-raster-rounding to car2-a2-core-wiring dependsOn (plan file and overview updated).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Both plans add cases to apps/cli/src/capture-command.test.ts; without an explicit edge the two owners had no ordering in the DAG. The wave numbers are unchanged (r is wave 1, core-wiring wave 3).

intentionalTradeoffs: Five-wave critical path (a1-rust-decoder -> a2-native-host -> a2-core-wiring -> a4-open-mesh-targets -> a5-charged-walk); a slip delays R2-1 and R2-3.
After the point-limit excess, a mesh that a later feature targets may still allocate bounded target scratch (1 MiB inline cap) so that feature status matches an admitted walk.
R2-4 nested same-depth siblings stay super-linear (O(siblings x children)); the audited perforated plate is linear.
R2-1 agreement with Manifold is limited to the nine fixtures of design 19.1.
decodeNmesh gains only onAllocate; the over-limit path routes through inspectNmesh instead of a maxVertices option (accepted minor divergence from R2-D wording).
chargeTool charges a whole prism before the writer's per-loop mismatch check; ordering differs only for internally inconsistent models the builder never produces.
CLOSURE_EVALUATIONS is process-wide and asserted only in its own single-test binary closure_count.rs.
supportedEdgeCases: Eligibility fixtures: single triangle, mixed-winding tetrahedron, double-sided triangle, coplanar tetrahedron and translated flat shell rejected; tetrahedron in both orientations, thin bar and translated thin bar accepted; hidden meshes follow the same rule.
Corrupt mesh input on both full and over-limit decoder paths gives the same error with zero geometry allocations; empty meshes are failures in capture and wireframe.
Point limit exactly 4,000,000 admitted; first excess; visible, hidden and mesh long tails; hidden-only overflow; body-query and writer-header precedence.
Full, partial and nested-island loop selections.
Interference tolerance-boundary pairs at, just below and just above scene.tolerance on each axis; keep in {0, 1, 3, all}.
Stale picker option clicked in the same reactive batch as the page conversion; Undo restoring eligibility.
Decimal rounding boundary of a 10000 x 100 viewport at scale 0.07 and a 700 x 7 box.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Transient sibling failures in the shared working tree (rerun after the sibling is done and record both runs).
Desktop Tauri-side mesh decoding (the desktop never decodes meshes in Rust).
Pre-existing environmental test failures, compared in isolation before reporting.
